nodes.title: Image + Audio to Video (LTX-2.5) - Lipsync
Note: About LTX-2.5
widgets_values:
# LTX-2.5 Long-form Lipsync

**One portrait + a long audio track -> a minutes-long lipsynced video.**

LTX-2.5 caps out around 10s, so this renders one chunk per queue item and uses
ComfyUI's batch count as the loop. The last chunk stitches everything automatically -
there is no ffmpeg step for you to run.

## Run it

1. **Load Image** = your portrait. **Load Audio** = the FULL track.
2. Queue **once** with `chunk_index = 0`. Read `total_chunks` from the console
   (`[LTX Longform] chunk 1/NN ...`).
3. Leave `chunk_index` on **increment**, then Queue with **batch count = NN**.
4. The final chunk writes `longform_final.mp4` to `output/`.

## Knobs

- `reanchor_every` (node 2) - every N chunks, restart from the portrait instead of
  chaining. Lower = identity holds better, more visible resets. 6 is a good start.
- `target/min/max_seconds` (node 1) - chunk length. Cuts are nudged toward pauses so
  they do not land mid-word.
- `fps` - **leave at 24.** Frame counts must satisfy `frames % 8 == 1`; at 24fps every
  whole-second duration works, at 25/30/50 most round down and drift the audio.

## Notes

- Chunks must run **in order** and share one `session`. To redo one, queue that index
  with the same session, then run the last chunk again.
- Describe only **motion and delivery** in the prompt - never the dialogue (that comes
  from your audio) and never hair/clothing (restating them accelerates drift).
- Leave `prompt_enhance` **off**.
- ~50 chunks for 7 minutes, roughly 2-3 hours on a 48GB card.
- Intermediates in `output/ltx_longform/<session>/`; stitching refuses to run if any
  chunk is missing rather than silently shifting the timeline.

nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Models used

All are pulled automatically by the template's `setup.sh`.

- `ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors` -> `models/diffusion_models/`
- `gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors` -> `models/text_encoders/`
- `ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors` -> `models/vae/`
- `ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors` -> `models/vae/`  *(encodes your input audio)*
- `ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors` -> `models/latent_upscale_models/`
- `gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot.safetensors` -> `models/text_encoders/` *(prompt enhancer only)*

## Input assets

Drop your own files in `ComfyUI/input/`, or upload them through the Load Image /
Load Audio nodes.

Guide: [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)
